papers.reason: reviews AI ethics and best practices in academic writing narratively; discusses the importance of disclosing AI use in prose but proposes no named or enumerable scheme of disclosure/attribution dimensions, only a generic AI-capability classification (narrow/general/super intelligence) and a narrative list of accepted AI-use scenarios not framed as a disclosure or provenance scheme
